note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole verse, verses joined with a space, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. `self_rendered` rows are allusions and paraphrases in Hannah Whitall Smith's own voice, quotations recast into her sentence, the book's title phrase 'the God of all comfort' (OWB 2 Cor 1:3 words it differently), and places where she argues from a wording OWB does not carry (Num 21:4 'discouraged', Acts 20:24 AV, 2 Chr 32:15 'how much less'); each carries a `why`. Three citations the English gets wrong are corrected in the Amharic: Prov 18:10, 2 Sam 7:22-24, Zech 11:17.
